overview: After watching their respective partners die, a cop and a hitman form an alliance in order to bring down their common enemy.

recs.blurb: A friendship is formed between an ex-gangster, and two groups of hitmen - those who want to protect him and those who were sent to kill him.

In Manhattan, a bike messenger picks up an envelope that attracts the interest of a dirty cop, who pursues the cyclist throughout the city.
